_meta.method: So buoc tu Ma-ha-ca-diep (doi 1) + 1 = doi; chuoi truyen phap thay-tro da xac nhan cho cac muc trang_thai=locked. DILA ID da kiem chung truc tiep cho tung muc locked.
_meta.unresolved_rule: 11 vi (doi 4,7,9,10,11,13,16,18,19,21,22) cua 28 To An Do CHUA co DILA ID da kiem chung trong ban nay - de trang_thai=unresolved, KHONG doan ID (xem docs/rules/data-integrity.md, docs/rules/naming-and-identity.md: ten/alias khong bao gio la join key, ID phai xac minh truoc khi dung).
_meta.dila_id_format: DILA Person ID, dang A\d+ (xem docs/rules/naming-and-identity.md: Person | DILA Person ID | A000001 | people.id). Trong person_gen_computed, day la person_id cua node DILA (lineage_key='dila_global').
_meta.ten_han_note: ten_han = null khi Admin chua cung cap Han danh da xac minh trong lan khoa nay (2026-11-07) - khong doan Han danh tu suy luan/kien thuc chung, chi dien khi co nguon xac nhan.
